recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future wording changes for the operation cycle or operation duration concepts should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack unless active core Device text stops pointing to the correct extension definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-47038 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core OO issue raised for R6 asking to clarify the short and long descriptions of Device.cycle and Device.duration. Its final resolution says the issue is resolved as part of FHIR-47323.
initial_application: Core commit 9d3783acc0 for FHIR-48924 commented out Device.mode, Device.cycle, and Device.duration in source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml after FHIR-32565 approved moving those elements into extensions. Extension-pack commit 8b6b7b0 for FHIR-47323 created device-operation-cycle and device-operation-duration with clarified descriptions and comments. The combined branch already includes FHIR-48924 commit 3a2c936081, which corrected active core Device text to reference the actual operation extension ids.
additional_context: Device remains active in source/fhir.ini, but the old Device.cycle and Device.duration elements are inside an XML comment and are not current core conformance elements. The active Device ballot note says these elements were removed and points to device-operation-cycle and device-operation-duration. OO WGM minutes for 2025-01-27/31 record FHIR-47038 as resolved as part of FHIR-47323 with an 11-0-2 vote; focused Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The required durable outcome for this core checkout is an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the substantive wording is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack.
